name: M3U-Editor
description: Manage IPTV playlists, EPG guides and Xtream output in one place

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The built-in PostgreSQL database (playlists, channels, EPG, users).

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: M3U Editor web app, playlists, EPG and Xtream API, published on host as 6153

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: The address used in your playlist, EPG and Xtream links, like http://192.168.1.20:6153. Change localhost to your server IP so players on other devices can use the links.

variables.name: ENABLE_POSTGRES
variables.description: Runs the PostgreSQL database built into the image. Keep it at true.

variables.name: DB_CONNECTION
variables.description: Tells the app to use that database. Keep it at pgsql.

variables.name: PG_DATABASE
variables.description: The name of the built-in database. Must match DB_DATABASE.

variables.name: PG_USER
variables.description: The user of the built-in database. Must match DB_USERNAME.

variables.name: PG_PASSWORD
variables.description: Pre-filled with a random password for the built-in database. You can replace it before the first start (letters and numbers only). Must match DB_PASSWORD. It is locked in on the first start.

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: The database runs inside the same container. Keep it at localhost.

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: The database port inside the container. Keep it at 5432.
